About PrevitLab Inc.

PrevitLab Inc. (프레빗랩 주식회사, PreVIT LAB) is a Korean software company that turns small, everyday ideas into working services, built quickly with AI.

Products

  • Moket — moket.kr, an AI tool recommendation and comparison service for Korean users. Moket helps people find AI tools that fit their job and task, and includes Jev, a built-in assistant that suggests tools for a task described in plain language.
  • MODN Calculator — an all-in-one calculator app for Android covering everyday, finance, fitness, education and engineering calculations (Google Play).
